title: Epstein's keycard access to Harvard evolutionary dynamics program

tellings.quote: And he was involved in the evolutionary dynamics uh biology sub program at Harvard. He had keycard access to that.

plain: The financier Jeffrey Epstein is said to have been involved in an evolutionary biology program at Harvard University and to have had a keycard to get into it. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells this, naming the evolutionary biologist Robert Trivers and the geneticist George Church in the same account. He raises it to suggest Epstein had close access to research on human evolution and genetics.
